local _MI = 1

local bit32bxor = bit32 and bit32.bxor or function(a,b)
  local r,ba,bb,c = 0,1,1,1
  a = a % 4294967296; b = b % 4294967296
  while a>0 or b>0 do
    local abit,bbit = a%2,b%2
    if abit~=bbit then r=r+c end
    a=(a-abit)/2; b=(b-bbit)/2; c=c*2
  end
  return r
end

local function _decstr(cipher)
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #cipher do
    out[i] = string.char(bit32bxor(string.byte(cipher, i), _K[((i-1) % #_K) + 1]))
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

for i = 1, #_C do
  if _CT[i] == 1 then _C[i] = _decstr(_C[i]) end
end

local _fieldN = 0
local function _decfield(v)
  local k = _IK[(_fieldN % #_IK) + 1]
  _fieldN = _fieldN + 1
  local r = bit32bxor(v % 4294967296, k)
  if r >= 2147483648 then r = r - 4294967296 end
  return r
end

for pi = 1, #_P do
  local code = _P[pi].code
  for ii = 1, #code do
    local ins = code[ii]
    ins[1] = _decfield(ins[1]); ins[2] = _decfield(ins[2]); ins[3] = _decfield(ins[3]); ins[4] = _decfield(ins[4])
  end
end

local function _ok(fn)
  local ok, src = pcall(function() return debug.info(fn, "s") end)
  return ok and src == "[C]"
end
local function _integrityCheck()
  local crit = {print, pairs, ipairs, type, pcall, setmetatable, rawget, rawset, tostring, select}
  for i = 1, #crit do
    if type(crit[i]) ~= "function" then error("integrity check failed", 0) end
  end
  if debug and debug.info then
    for i = 1, #crit do
      if not _ok(crit[i]) then error("integrity check failed", 0) end

  for i = 1, #raw do
    sum = bit32bxor(sum, string.byte(raw, i)) % 4294967296
    sum = (sum * 16777619) % 4294967296
  end
  if sum ~= 3149537019 then error("integrity check failed", 0) end
end
_integrityCheck()

local _MARK = setmetatable({}, {__tostring = function() return "\0MARK" end})
local _CLOSUREMT = { __call = function(self, ...) return _callclosure(self, {...}, select("#", ...)) end }

local function _envFallbackIndex(_, k)
  local ok, v = pcall(function() return _G[k] end)
  if ok then return v end
  return nil
end
local ENV = setmetatable({
  print=print, warn=warn, error=error, assert=assert, type=type, typeof=typeof,
  tostring=tostring, tonumber=tonumber, pairs=pairs, ipairs=ipairs, next=next,
  pcall=pcall, xpcall=xpcall, select=select, unpack=unpack or table.unpack,
  rawget=rawget, rawset=rawset, rawequal=rawequal, rawlen=rawlen,
  setmetatable=setmetatable, getmetatable=getmetatable, require=require,
  math=math, string=string, table=table, os=os, coroutine=coroutine,
  bit32=bit32, utf8=utf8, buffer=buffer,
  game=game, workspace=workspace, script=script, shared=shared, _G=_G,
  wait=wait, spawn=spawn, delay=delay, tick=tick, time=time, task=task,
  Instance=Instance, Vector2=Vector2, Vector3=Vector3, CFrame=CFrame,
  Color3=Color3, UDim=UDim, UDim2=UDim2, Ray=Ray, Region3=Region3,
  BrickColor=BrickColor, ColorSequence=ColorSequence, NumberSequence=NumberSequence,
  NumberRange=NumberRange, Enum=Enum, Random=Random, TweenInfo=TweenInfo,
  DateTime=DateTime, PhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties, Axes=Axes, Faces=Faces,
  loadstring=rawget(_G or {}, "loadstring"), getfenv=rawget(_G or {}, "getfenv"),
  setfenv=rawget(_G or {}, "setfenv"),
}, { __index = _envFallbackIndex, __newindex = function(t, k, v) rawset(t, k, v) end })

local function _packcall(fn, args, n)
  local res = table.pack(fn(table.unpack(args, 1, n)))
  return res, res.n
end

function _callclosure(closure, args, nargs)
  local proto = _P[closure._pi]
  local locals = {}
  for i = 1, proto.ns do locals[i] = { v = nil } end
  for i = 1, proto.np do locals[i].v = args[i] end
  local varargs = nil
  if proto.va == 1 then
    local n = nargs - proto.np
    if n < 0 then n = 0 end
    varargs = { n = n }
    for i = 1, n do varargs[i] = args[proto.np + i] end
  end
  return _execute(proto, closure._uv, locals, varargs)
end

local function _callvalue(fn, args, nargs)
  local t = type(fn)
  if t == "function" then
    return _packcall(fn, args, nargs)
  elseif t == "table" and fn._pi then
    return _callclosure(fn, args, nargs)
  else
    error("attempt to call a " .. t .. " value", 0)
  end
end

function _execute(proto, upvals, locals, varargs)
  local code = proto.code
  local st = {}
  local top = 0
  local pc = 0
  while true do
    local instr = code[pc + 1]
    local op, a, b, c = instr[1], instr[2], instr[3], instr[4]

    if op == 72 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = locals[a + 1].v
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 88 then
      locals[a + 1].v = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 106 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = _C[a + 1]
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 24 then
      local vals, n = {}, 0
      while st[top] ~= _MARK do n = n + 1; vals[n] = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1 end
      st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      local fn = vals[n]
      local args, nargs = {}, n - 1
      for i = 1, nargs do args[i] = vals[n - i] end
      local results, nres = _callvalue(fn, args, nargs)
      if b == -1 then
        for i = 1, nres do top = top + 1; st[top] = results[i] end
      elseif b > 0 then
        for i = 1, b do top = top + 1; st[top] = results[i] end
      end
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 47 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = _MARK
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 58 then
      local vals, n = {}, 0
      while st[top] ~= _MARK do n = n + 1; vals[n] = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1 end
      st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      local ordered = {}
      for i = 1, n do ordered[i] = vals[n - i + 1] end
      return ordered, n
    elseif op == 77 then
      pc = a
    elseif op == 114 then
      local cond = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      if cond ~= nil and cond ~= false then pc = a else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 155 then
      local cond = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      if cond == nil or cond == false then pc = a else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 78 then
      local cond = st[top]
      if cond ~= nil and cond ~= false then pc = a else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 22 then
      local cond = st[top]
      if cond == nil or cond == false then pc = a else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 162 then
      for i = 1, a do st[top] = nil; top = top - 1 end
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 11 then
      local v = st[top]; top = top + 1; st[top] = v
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 23 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = nil
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 65 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = (a == 1)
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 147 then
      local n = varargs and varargs.n or 0
      if a == -1 then
        for i = 1, n do top = top + 1; st[top] = varargs[i] end
      else
        for i = 1, a do top = top + 1; st[top] = varargs and varargs[i] or nil end
      end
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 168 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = upvals[a + 1].v
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 90 then
      upvals[a + 1].v = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 124 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = ENV[_C[a + 1]]
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 51 then
      ENV[_C[a + 1]] = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 119 then
      top = top + 1; st[top] = {}
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 57 then
      local k = st[top]; local t = st[top - 1]
      st[top - 1] = t[k]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 91 then
      if a == 0 then
        local v = st[top]; local k = st[top-1]; local t = st[top-2]
        t[k] = v
        st[top]=nil; st[top-1]=nil; st[top-2]=nil; top = top - 3
      else
        local k = st[top]; local t = st[top-1]; local v = st[top-2]
        t[k] = v
        st[top]=nil; st[top-1]=nil; st[top-2]=nil; top = top - 3
      end
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 153 then
      local vals, n = {}, 0
      while st[top] ~= _MARK do n = n + 1; vals[n] = st[top]; st[top] = nil; top = top - 1 end
      st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      local t = st[top]
      for i = 1, n do t[a + i - 1] = vals[n - i + 1] end
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 44 then
      local obj = st[top]
      local fn = obj[_C[a + 1]]
      st[top] = fn
      top = top + 1; st[top] = obj
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 26 then
      local rhs = st[top]; local lhs = st[top-1]
      st[top] = nil; top = top - 1
      local r
      if a == 0 then r = lhs + rhs
      elseif a == 1 then r = lhs - rhs
      elseif a == 2 then r = lhs * rhs
      elseif a == 3 then r = lhs / rhs
      elseif a == 4 then r = lhs % rhs
      elseif a == 5 then r = lhs ^ rhs
      elseif a == 6 then r = lhs // rhs
      elseif a == 7 then r = lhs .. rhs
      elseif a == 8 then r = lhs == rhs
      elseif a == 9 then r = lhs ~= rhs
      elseif a == 10 then r = lhs < rhs
      elseif a == 11 then r = lhs <= rhs
      elseif a == 12 then r = lhs > rhs
      elseif a == 13 then r = lhs >= rhs
      end
      st[top] = r
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 8 then
      local v = st[top]
      local r
      if a == 0 then r = -v
      elseif a == 1 then r = not (v ~= nil and v ~= false)
      elseif a == 2 then r = #v
      end
      st[top] = r
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 123 then
      local pidx = a + 1
      local cp = _P[pidx]
      local uvs = {}
      for i = 1, #cp.uv do
        local d = cp.uv[i]
        if d[1] == 0 then uvs[i] = locals[d[2] + 1] else uvs[i] = upvals[d[2] + 1] end
      end
      top = top + 1
      st[top] = setmetatable({ _pi = pidx, _uv = uvs }, _CLOSUREMT)
      pc = pc + 1
    elseif op == 18 then
      local step = st[top]; local stop = st[top-1]; local start = st[top-2]
      st[top]=nil; st[top-1]=nil; st[top-2]=nil; top = top - 3
      if step == 0 then error("'for' step is zero", 0) end
      locals[a+1] = { v = start }
      locals[a+2] = { v = stop }
      locals[a+3] = { v = step }
      if (step > 0 and start > stop) or (step < 0 and start < stop) then pc = b else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 82 then
      local box, limitBox, stepBox = locals[a+1], locals[a+2], locals[a+3]
      local nv = box.v + stepBox.v
      box.v = nv
      local cont
      if stepBox.v > 0 then cont = nv <= limitBox.v else cont = nv >= limitBox.v end
      if cont then pc = b else pc = pc + 1 end
    elseif op == 84 then
      local fn, state, control = locals[a+1].v, locals[a+2].v, locals[a+3].v
      local rv, _n = _callvalue(fn, {state, control}, 2)
      for i = 1, b do
        locals[c + 1 + (i - 1)].v = rv[i]
      end
      locals[a+3].v = rv[1]
      pc = pc + 1
    else
      error("VM: opcode desconhecido", 0)
    end
  end
end

local _mainProto = _P[_MI]
local _mainLocals = {}
for i = 1, _mainProto.ns do _mainLocals[i] = { v = nil } end
local _nargs = select("#", ...)
local _args = { ... }
local _mainVarargs = { n = _nargs }
for i = 1, _nargs do _mainVarargs[i] = _args[i] end
return (_execute(_mainProto, {}, _mainLocals, _mainVarargs))
